'''Noah Singer''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Las Vegas tournament]] on 29 January 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d217">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-31-las-vegas-nevada-01-29-00d217/ las-vegas-nevada-01-29-00], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 31 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-31-las-vegas-nevada-01-29-00d217/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
